title: Settle Resume reporters on delegation-detach failure paths
outcome: A delegation detach that discards a Resume payload cancels its reporter off StateInner, including persistence-error exits, so a visible child's feedback cannot remain Scheduled indefinitely.
acceptance: mark_delegation_failed_after_start_error and terminal-detach callers that return before refresh side effects settle each removed reporter off-lock on normal and persistence-error paths, without duplicate provider delivery.
Regression tests prove exact-row terminal or Unknown settlement once for normal and commit-failure detach paths, and the maintained full gate passes.
